orphanFallback.rationale: Oppy introduces this restriction as his own general account of argumentative utility, so it independently advances the con route without requiring an earlier opposing move.

orphanFallback.rationale: The source states Oppy's positive method for choosing between whole theories, which remains a freestanding constructive alternative even if no earlier opposing clarification is retained.
